name: are-you-sure-bro
description: Mod: confirms only dangerous Bash commands (data loss, irreversible) and writes to sensitive files; optional strictness and noisy-output cap

capLines.title: Output cap (lines)
capLines.description: Lines to keep when you choose to cap a noisy command

guardWrites.title: Guard sensitive writes
guardWrites.description: Ask before Write/Edit touches .env, SSH keys, credentials, .git hooks, /etc

extraRisky.title: Extra risky pattern
extraRisky.description: Optional regex; commands matching it ask for confirmation too

level.title: Strictness
level.description: dangerous: only commands that lose data or cannot be undone. careful: also pushes to main/master, sudo, find -delete, terraform apply, kubectl delete and similar

capNoisy.title: Offer to cap noisy output
capNoisy.description: Also ask before commands that tend to print a lot (cat, ls -R, test runs, logs) and offer to cap them. Off by default
